stem.text: One control method to reduce the spread of malaria is to use an insecticide. It can be used to treat mosquito nets.
Another control method is to completely cover areas of water with insoluble polystyrene balls that float on the surface.
Using this information, what are the reasons for these control methods?

A.text: kills all male mosquitoes; prevents adult mosquitoes from laying eggs

B.text: kills all mosquitoes; releases toxins that kill mosquito larvae

C.text: kills some mosquitoes; restricts the breathing of the mosquito larvae

D.text: prevents mosquitoes from breeding; reduces nutrient supply for mosquito larvae

A:
prevents adult mosquitoes
from laying eggs
B:
releases toxins that
kill mosquito larvae
C:
restricts the breathing of
the mosquito larvae

reduces nutrient supply
for mosquito larvae
